problem: His fuel order is blocked and nobody will answer
action: Harsh midday. The dealer is walking slowly across his own empty forecourt with a mobile phone pressed hard to his right ear, his left hand on his hip. His head is tilted down. He is listening to a phone that is not being answered — the particular stillness of a man waiting through a ringtone. The forecourt around him is completely empty of vehicles and customers.
lighting: Flat brutal overhead noon light, almost no shadows, washed-out sky, heat shimmer off the concrete. Unflattering and hot.
camera: Waist-up, walking towards camera but off-centre, slightly wide so the emptiness of the forecourt reads around him. He is sharp, background soft. 35mm.
detail: The phone is held tight enough that his knuckles show. His jaw is set. Screen not visible. No vehicles anywhere. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Being ignored. The specific anger of a man who cannot get anyone on the phone and has customers coming.
motion: He walks two slow steps closer and lowers the phone from his ear a few inches, then puts it back. A slow push in. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody else enters frame, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: लोड नहीं लग रहा। सेल्स ऑफ़िसर फ़ोन नहीं उठा रहे। दिक़्क़त क्या है, मालूम ही नहीं।
